protocol_notes: PointArena official scorer checks count; public Molmo2 PointBenchEval does not. Do not silently conflate these protocols.
RoboSpatial current code notes changed context evaluation after 2026-05-13, later than MolmoAct2 v1 paper.
Molmo2 public eval script sets max_crops at least 24 and context 64000; our fast matched profile uses max_crops=2 and context4096.
OpenEQA is actually in the paper table, not an unrelated generalization benchmark.
